svg.title: ToneDial screen (en · doctor-recovery-invalid)
svg.desc:
ToneDial · doctor
Inspection scope: global <ROOT>
An unreadable operation record is blocking recovery. No files were changed by this command.
Operation ID: ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff Quarantine it before rebuilding; the original bytes remain available through rollback. tonedial doctor --fix --quarantine-operation ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff --global
